svg.title: C · The reset is a boundary

g.text: C · The reset is a boundary
A760 first; supported old fixtures begin after it
Existing pre-live folders use the old migration history. A799 does not approve moving them through A760 or resetting any box.
The separate operator job records resets or quarantine. The physical home box remains the owner’s job. Nothing in this design starts that work.
After A760, pin the first qualifying image and its product-created venue. A later image must apply pending migrations and preserve those facts;
restarting the same image is only a control.
Do not call this blocker closed. An optional pre-squash refusal rehearsal is a separate result, never a successful preservation test.
Illustrative review board. No implementation is approved.
